Patient: Odile Haddad | DOB: 03/13/1952 | MRN: SYN-9489767
Date of service: 09/21/2025 | Dr. Kaveh Draycott, MD (Rheumatology)

History:
73-year-old woman with rheumatoid arthritis diagnosed in 2022, seen to discuss escalation of therapy. Past medical history: hyperlipidemia, gastroesophageal reflux.

Exam:
Synovitis of the MCP and PIP joints of both hands; no rheumatoid nodules.

Treatment history:
Inadequate response to methotrexate 15 mg weekly for 33 weeks despite good adherence.

Assessment and plan:
Assessment: seropositive rheumatoid arthritis, DAS28-CRP 4.3 (moderate disease activity).
Pre-biologic screening: tuberculosis and hepatitis B screens negative.
Plan: start fictimab 40 mg subcutaneously every 14 days.
